formulas.name: The Contrarian
formulas.template: Everyone thinks [Common Belief], but [Surprising Truth].
formulas.example: Everyone thinks diamonds are rare, but warehouses are overflowing with them.

formulas.name: The Micro-Story
formulas.template: In [Year/Place], [Subject] did something that changed [Outcome] forever.
formulas.example: In 1971, one man bought a one-way ticket, jumped out of a Boeing 727, and vanished.

formulas.name: The Secret Mechanism
formulas.template: The real reason [Entity] never talks about [Subject].
formulas.example: The real reason airlines paint all their planes white will surprise you.

formulas.name: The Impossible Juxtaposition
formulas.template: How [Underdog/Unlikely Element] managed to [Incredible Feat].
formulas.example: How a teenage janitor accidentally cracked a 50-year-old CIA encryption.
formulas.best_for: Human interest, unexpected triumphs, bizarre events

formulas.name: The Statistic
formulas.template: [Percentage]% of people don't realize [Shocking Fact].
formulas.example: 99% of people don't realize the ocean floor is younger than the dinosaurs.

formulas.name: The Warning
formulas.template: If you ever see [Unusual Sign], [Urgent Action] immediately.
formulas.example: If you ever see square waves in the ocean, get out of the water immediately.
formulas.best_for: Survival tips, tech safety, life hacks

formulas.name: The Forbidden Knowledge
formulas.template: What [Authority/Company] doesn't want you to know about [Subject].
formulas.example: What supermarkets do to the lighting in the meat aisle to trick your brain.

formulas.name: The Challenge
formulas.template: Only 1 in 100 people can spot what's wrong with this [Object/Statement].
formulas.example: Only 1 in 100 people can figure out how this bank robbery succeeded with zero weapons.

formulas.name: The Direct Accusation
formulas.template: You are doing [Everyday Action] completely wrong.
formulas.example: You have been charging your phone wrong this entire time, and it's killing the battery.

formulas.name: The Curiosity Loophole
formulas.template: There is a legal loophole that allows [Shocking Permission].
formulas.example: There is an island where nobody is legally allowed to be born or buried.

formulas.name: The Timeline Twist
formulas.template: In just [Short Duration], [Subject] lost [Massive Asset].
formulas.example: In just 14 seconds, this trader lost 440 million dollars with a single click.
formulas.best_for: Finance disasters, rapid downfall stories, military blunders

formulas.name: The Cost of Free
formulas.template: [Free Product] is free for a reason, and you won't like it.
formulas.example: Free flight tracking apps aren't making money from ads—here's the dark truth.

formulas.name: The Glitch in History
formulas.template: The historical coincidence that sounds too absurd to be real.
formulas.example: The bizarre coincidence of two total strangers who lived identical lives down to their dogs' names.

formulas.name: The Unsolved Mystery
formulas.template: Science can explain [Complex Topic], but has zero answers for this.
formulas.example: Science can map distant galaxies, but still has no idea why we yawn.

formulas.name: The Hidden Feature
formulas.template: This hidden button in your [Everyday Item] was designed for an emergency.
formulas.example: This hidden latch inside elevator ceilings isn't what movies told you.

formulas.name: The Worst Decision
formulas.template: The most catastrophic decision in [Domain] history.
formulas.example: The film company that gave away all Star Wars toy rights for free.
formulas.best_for: Business blunders, history fails, regret stories

formulas.name: The Lie You Believe
formulas.template: You were taught this in school, but it's 100% false.
formulas.example: You were taught that Mount Everest is the tallest mountain on Earth. It's not.

formulas.name: The Survival Rule
formulas.template: The rule of [Number] that could save your life in [Dangerous Situation].
formulas.example: The 3-second rule that pilots use when their cockpit instruments fail.

formulas.name: The Bizarre Origin
formulas.template: The horrifying original purpose of [Everyday Item].
formulas.example: The shocking reason bubble wrap was originally invented.

formulas.name: The One-Second Mistake
formulas.template: One tiny typo that caused a [Monumental Disaster].
formulas.example: One missing hyphen in NASA's code caused a rocket to explode in 1962.
formulas.best_for: Tech fails, engineering disasters, military accidents

formulas.name: The Inversion
formulas.template: Stop doing [Standard Advice]. Do this instead.
formulas.example: Stop setting 5 AM alarms to be productive. Elite performers do this instead.
